Vendored PHP dependencies for the ZEAM Bridge settlement core.
Resolved with Composer 2 on 2026-09-26: composer require simplito/elliptic-php kornrunner/keccak
Only library sources and license files are copied; tests, docs, benchmarks and build files are left out.
Comments are removed from the PHP sources (PHP tokenizer: T_COMMENT and T_DOC_COMMENT tokens, trailing whitespace, runs of blank lines), 2026-10-01; the code is otherwise upstream's. License files are verbatim.
Loaded by ../autoload.php; no Composer at runtime.
symfony/polyfill-mbstring (required by kornrunner/keccak) is NOT vendored: Keccak only calls mb_strlen/mb_substr with the 8bit encoding, which ext-mbstring or WordPress core's compat functions provide; ZeamPass\Core::missing() reports their absence.
